notes.title: MapHub 1.0 available now!
notes.content:
MapHub is now out of early access!

1.0 update comes with 2 new languages (French and German)! Stay tuned for the future 1.1 update coming in the upcoming months!

We're also proud to announce our new project Share-o-matic: wishlist it today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162150/Shareomatic/

notes.title: MapHub v.0.9.5.0 is live!
notes.content:
MapHub v.0.9.5.0 - aka the Adventurer Update - is live!

[list]

[*] New languages! Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian!

[*] added quests 

    - creators can create quests, which consist of several steps and are connected to points of interest 
    - users can track quests and their progress 

[*] added tool to take screenshots of maps 

[*] various fixes 

[/list]

notes.title: MapHub v.0.9.2.0 is live!
notes.content:
MapHub v.0.9.2.0 - aka the Cartographer Update - is live!

[list]
[*] added tool to generate simple icons from text letters or emojis
[*] added layer import from Tiled ( https://www.mapeditor.org ) json project files 
[*] various quality of life improvements and fixes 
[/list]
